evidence_quotes.O: I spent a week playing with the Seagate FreeAgent GoFlex Net STAK100 before writing this review.
evidence_quotes.C: I ran each test 4 times. The router was about 30ft from the macbook pro with some obstructions. Everything was kept constant for all tests.
evidence_quotes.E: I won't go into too much detail because I really just want to add my own perspective.
evidence_quotes.A: Since it often comes down to reliability and performance I thought I'd run some tests myself. Hopefully others will find this useful.
evidence_quotes.N: Well my flash unit died after a few months. I changed the batteries and fiddled with it but no luck.
